name: Simeon
bio: Simeon, a righteous and devout man in Jerusalem waiting for Israel's consolation, had been told by the Holy Spirit that he would not die before seeing the Lord's Christ. When Mary and Joseph brought the infant Jesus to the temple, Simeon, led by the Spirit, took the child in his arms and blessed God, declaring he could now depart in peace, having seen the salvation prepared for Gentiles and Israel alike. He blessed Mary and Joseph and prophesied to Mary that the child was destined to cause the rise and fall of many in Israel and to be a sign spoken against, and that a sword would pierce her own soul (Luke 2:25-35). He is a different figure from Simeon, the son of Jacob.
